intro: WARNING: all activity on this node is logged.
CASE #404: Mara Voss, lead sysadmin, has vanished.
You have read access to the company network. Find out who did it.
Start with:  cat briefing.txt     (type 'help' for all commands)

briefing.txt: Mara Voss, Halcyon's lead sysadmin, missed her shift three days ago.
Her phone is off and her apartment is empty.
A friend says she told them: 'If I disappear, look in the vault.'
Explore the system, collect evidence, then run:  accuse <last name>
Tip: 'notes' shows every clue you have logged so far.

notes.txt: Northgate Consulting is a shell. The payments are all approved by one person.
The key is my cat's name, written backwards.
(He is asleep on my keyboard as I type this.)

Thanks for covering my on-call, Tomas.
02_kessler.txt: Mara - drop the Northgate audit. It is not an IT matter.
I will handle finance myself. Do not make me escalate this.
03_ward.txt: Mara's leave request for next month is approved. Nothing unusual.
04_priest.txt: I am at my SOC desk 18:00-06:00 all week. Camera feeds are archived.

ledger.enc: Registered owner of Northgate: Kessler Holdings LLC
Mara's last memo: 'He knows I know. I'm going to the police.'
